Summary: A patient creates a new account to use the booking service.
A patient searches for a suitable doctor by criteria.
A patient selects a time slot and confirms a booking.
A patient cancels or reschedules to another slot.
Receptionist reviews and confirms a new booking.
The system automatically sends a reminder notification.
Doctor records visit outcomes into the patient's record.
The system checks a prescription against known allergy/interaction history.
Postconditions: Warning is shown if a risk is detected

Summary: Admin adds/edits/removes doctor and specialty information.
Admin views operational statistics for a given period.
A patient or receptionist checks whether the patient's insurance policy is valid for the selected visit.
Preconditions: Patient is logged in and a policy number is available
Postconditions: Coverage status (valid/invalid/pending) is returned and stored with the appointment

Summary: The system grants or denies access to features according to the authenticated user's role.
Postconditions: Only role-permitted operations succeed; unauthorized requests are rejected
